context: A teacher and a teen review a project on consumer issues
purpose: Teach: 酵素/混同/判る/落ち着か/投下/党員/政界/接待

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、酵素を巡る誤解、自由研究のテーマね。
lines.en: Sakura, misconceptions about enzymes — that's your research theme.
lines.style: Open with genuine curiosity. Warm confirmation. Steady pace, teacher's attentiveness. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting her to continue.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。サプリと混同しないよう、判るような図を作りました。
lines.en: Yes. I made diagrams to clarify things so people don't mix them up with supplements.
lines.style: Measured and precise. Slight pride in the work without boasting. Direct eye contact level. Careful articulation on technical words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 落ち着かない消費者層への教育、章として大切ですね。
lines.en: Educating consumers on this is really important — especially as a standalone section of your work.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly with conviction. Warm affirmation. Light emphasis on 「大切」. The tone of a teacher recognizing real thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 情報投下の頻度、行政に依存している点、課題です。
lines.en: The real challenge is how often we can get that information out there — we're too dependent on government channels right now.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not uncertain. Measured pacing. She's testing her teacher's thinking, not doubting herself. Quiet intelligence. Slight pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 党員候補や政界の関心、接待が絡まないよう、健全に。
lines.en: With politicians and candidates interested, we need to keep this entirely separate from any influence or favors — keep it pure.
lines.style: Shift to more serious, protective tone. Slightly slower, each phrase weighted. The caution of someone who sees a good project and wants to guard its integrity.
